name: Yuuwaku no Toiki
source:
Tetsuya is a 4th grade college student who takes up a part-time job to tutor one of the daughters of a famous novelist in his mansion. But for a salary of 1 million yen per month he also agrees to serve as bodyguard to novelist's wife Ayako whose life is endangered by an unknown person.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-september-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
香贺哲哉是一名大学四年级学生，受聘到著名小说家的宅邸，为对方的一名女儿担任家庭教师。不过，为了每月100万日元的薪酬，他还同意兼任小说家妻子柊野木亚矢子的保镖。此时，一名身份不明的人正威胁着她的生命安全。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vndb-of-month-september-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
